description: Once every 3 seconds, increase your Health, Magicka, and Stamina by 2% for 10 seconds for each corpse within 12 meters, up to 10 times. While in combat, if no corpses are nearby, create a corpse.
Deflects the next direct damage attack made against you within 3 seconds. This can occur once every 3 seconds.
Heals you for 35% of the damage done.
Deals 2980 Physical Damage over 20 seconds to enemies.
Grants you the bonus of the Follow Up passive ability.
Removes and grants immunity to snares and immobilizations for 4 seconds.
